arguments.command:
cd /workspace/task && md5sum scratch/releases.json && python3 - <<'EOF'
import json
p='scratch/releases.json'
data=json.load(open(p,encoding='utf-8'))
out=[v for v in data if not v.endswith('-beta')]
out.sort(key=lambda v: tuple(int(x) for x in v.split('.')), reverse=True)
with open('scratch/stable.json','w',encoding='utf-8') as f:
    json.dump(out,f,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2)
    f.write('\n')
print(out)
EOF
md5sum scratch/releases.json; cat scratch/stable.json; file scratch/stable.json
